note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'long ball' (Higgins' ball) through 'chases her down', 'The back-pass', 'Akers pounces', 'round the keeper' to 'goal' (the ball crossing the line): keep the pauses at '...' so the move plays near real time. Chapter 3 holds the slow motion on 'deep breath' before 'passes it in'.

chapters.label: The winner, live
chapters.text: Guangzhou, 1991, the first Women's World Cup final. One-one, two minutes left. Norway's defender wins a long ball, but Michelle Akers chases her down! The back-pass is short... Akers pounces, round the keeper... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again. Akers presses hard, so the defender has to rush. Her back-pass stops short, and Akers gets there first.

chapters.label: Stay calm
chapters.text: The angle is tight. She stays calm, takes a deep breath, and passes it in with her right foot.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: press defenders, pounce on mistakes, then stay calm and pass it into the net.
